# Clubic — contemporary French review

- Original source: [Clubic — contemporary French review](https://www.clubic.com/article-14935-1-robin-hood-la-legende-de-sherwood.html)
- Author / publication: Nerces / Clubic
- Language / date: French; 2002-12-06
- Access: Article text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Nerces praises the detailed, generally readable 2D environments and approachable controls. Camp assignments, complementary character abilities, and a partly open mission sequence give the familiar Commandos-style structure additional interest.

Repeated forest ambushes become tedious, and city assaults are criticized for confused, overly forgiving combat. The conclusion remains favorable, especially for genre enthusiasts, while suggesting that newcomers could first try cheaper copies of Commandos 2 or Desperados. That price comparison is historical.

The page mixes a standalone rating with an older category-score block, so no normalized score is inferred here. Its low hardware-demand claim is a contemporary Windows assessment, useful to compare with the Mac preview's performance complaints.
